checklist: Q3 / S6 (STRESS-MATRIX 5, WebContent killed during a cull): the probe's own web content process is SIGKILLed 5 times within a minute while culling. The probe answers each stop with the app's own SetsReloadPolicy (Host.swift repeats SetsRootView.webViewWebContentProcessDidTerminate; the policy is compiled in): stops 1-3 reload the page, stop 4 asks (the alert is logged, not shown) and nothing reloads on its own for 3 s, Try Again resets the count, stop 5 reloads. After each reload the shoot is reopened from the Open screen and every decision made more than 500 ms before the kill is back.

steps.why: the app's SetsReloadPolicy: 3 reloads a minute, then ask
a keep 700 ms before the crash: older than the 500 ms the session may lose
